part_gaps.gap: A movable, overlapping gill cover with a free rear edge is missing. Slits and exposed gill plumes represent different structures.
part_gaps.model_scope: One opercular flap and its attachment. Mirror the authored side.
part_gaps.local_fixture: Reuse a cheek patch with a gill opening. Check rear-edge overlap and clearance at closed and open poses. Use the opercular pumping study to select poses: https://doi.org/10.1111/j.1095-8649.2007.01416.x

part_gaps.gap: A broad, outward-facing digging hand with a widened medial edge is missing. Longer claws on an existing hand do not provide the same soil-contact silhouette.
part_gaps.model_scope: One forefoot with the broadened palm, medial support and digit row.
part_gaps.local_fixture: Reuse a wrist mount and a planar substrate. Check orientation and free digit clearance in representative compacting and scratching poses.

part_gaps.gap: Repeated lamellae under the digit provide a longitudinal contact surface that can peel. The anuran draft provides a single enlarged terminal contact instead.
part_gaps.model_scope: One digit with modeled pad boundaries and coarse lamellae, repeatable across a compatible foot.
part_gaps.local_fixture: Reuse a digit base and a flat contact plane. Check substrate clearance and the release pose using the study's hyperextension references.

part_gaps.gap: Opposing comb-like lamellae integrated into the margins of a bill form a route between the jaw edges. Hanging racks of baleen and a hooked bill cover different forms.
part_gaps.model_scope: One paired upper and lower bill-edge assembly with visible coarse lamellae.
part_gaps.local_fixture: Reuse a small jaw hinge and opposing bill edges. Check comb orientation and inter-row clearance through the intended opening.

part_gaps.gap: A broad proximal tail can form a load path from a pelvic root to a long grounded segment while both hindfeet lift. A free tail chain has no stable support surface.
part_gaps.reference_query: Scale-bearing lateral frames of one adult kangaroo walking pentapedally, with the leading forefoot support, tail contact patch and airborne hindfeet visible together.
part_gaps.model_scope: Tail root, proximal arc and ground-bearing ventral segment.
part_gaps.local_fixture: Use a pelvic block, two forefoot supports and floor. Check continuous ventral contact in the support pose and clearance during recovery.

part_gaps.function: Grooming with a paired digit comb
part_gaps.gap: Two distinct claw tips sit on digits enclosed in a shared sleeve beside larger free toes. An array of independently rooted claws lacks the shared base and cleft between the tips.
part_gaps.reference_query: Medial and plantar macro views of a scale-bearing adult pes with digits II and III visible in extension and reaching fur.
part_gaps.model_scope: Shared sheath of digits II and III, paired distal claws and adjacent foot attachment.
part_gaps.local_fixture: Use a foot-side mount and a curved fur proxy. Check shared proximal motion, claw tip spacing and clearance of the free adjacent digit.

part_gaps.function: Gliding across a limb-to-limb and tail web
part_gaps.gap: A continuous membrane terminates at all four limbs and extends along the tail, with anterior and lateral panels meeting at shared limb anchors. A wing and separate tail web leave discontinuities along those common boundaries.
part_gaps.reference_query: Scale-bearing dorsal and ventral spread specimen photographs with wrists, ankles, tail tip and every free membrane edge visible. Seek an additional folded pose.
part_gaps.model_scope: One interconnected membrane, from wrist and ankle anchor patches to the central tail edge.
part_gaps.local_fixture: Use torso, wrist, ankle and tail mounts. Check that panels remain joined in spread and folded poses and clear the limb tips.

part_gaps.function: Distributing load under a columnar limb
part_gaps.gap: A deep continuous plantar cushion supports a broad foot under a columnar limb, with discrete nails inserted into the perimeter wall. Neither a hard hoof capsule nor discrete pads captures the shared cushion-to-wall interface.
part_gaps.reference_query: Measure a scale-bearing plantar and frontal forefoot specimen and a corresponding standing side view, with heel cushion boundary and nail roots exposed.
part_gaps.model_scope: One forefoot shell, continuous plantar cushion and perimeter nail seats.
part_gaps.local_fixture: Use an axial limb mount and floor plate. Check that the wall, cushion and nails meet continuously with only the expected surfaces touching the floor.

part_gaps.function: Providing heel support inside a hoof capsule
part_gaps.gap: An inset V-shaped frog divides paired grooves and joins the rear heel buttresses inside the hollow sole. A rounded hoof or split count cannot encode an internal heel-to-sole support interface.
part_gaps.reference_query: Scale-bearing cleaned solar view and heel-on profile of the same unshod adult hoof with frog apex, collateral grooves and heel buttresses visible.
part_gaps.model_scope: Capsule rim, caudal heel buttresses, frog and sole recess.
part_gaps.local_fixture: Use a straight distal leg mount and ground plate. Check the heel, frog and lower wall elevations against the measured hoof and keep the grooves open.

part_gaps.gap: Two large toe-bearing lobes share a broad soft sole with a distal cleft and separate dorsal nails. Under stance the lobes can diverge while the proximal pad remains continuous.
part_gaps.reference_query: Scale-bearing plantar and frontal adult forefoot photographs during lifted swing and loaded stance so the contour of the pad and both nails can be traced.
part_gaps.model_scope: Two distal toe lobes, nail seats and continuous proximal pad.
part_gaps.local_fixture: Use a distal leg socket and contact plate. Compare cleft widths between poses and check that the proximal pad remains joined.

part_gaps.gap: An elongated narrow hand carries a close set of long hooks whose inner curves form the principal support against a branch. The proximal palm remains outside the branch-contact arc.
part_gaps.reference_query: Volar close-up with scale and true lateral view of the same forefoot hooked over a branch of visible diameter.
part_gaps.model_scope: Forefoot from wrist to hook row with reconstructed inner contact arcs.
part_gaps.local_fixture: Use a wrist mount and two branch diameters. Check hook contact and palm clearance under the branch and during withdrawal.

part_gaps.function: Maintaining protective cover while the trunk curls
part_gaps.gap: Near-transverse trunk bands connect fixed shoulder and pelvic shells and change overlap over a compliant waist during closure. The relative motion is carried by paired curved seams at the ends of the flexible belt.
part_gaps.reference_query: Seek calibrated dorsal, lateral and sectioned reference views that show all mobile bands between the fixed shells in extended and curled postures.
part_gaps.model_scope: Fixed front and rear shield margins plus the mobile-band belt.
part_gaps.local_fixture: Use two short trunk blocks and a flexing waist. Check overlap continuity in extension and curl, with no interpenetration between band rims.

part_gaps.function: Closing ventral gaps when a body curls
part_gaps.gap: A flexible perimeter around the spiny dorsal field contracts inward around the tucked underside. Closing the perimeter requires a deforming rim with inward roll, distinct from tilting individual spines.
part_gaps.reference_query: Scale-bearing overhead and low lateral views of the same adult unrolled and curled, including the visible closure slit and the outer boundary of the spine field.
part_gaps.model_scope: One circumferential soft-tissue skirt and its transition to a low-resolution spine-bearing surface.
part_gaps.local_fixture: Use a domed torso and small ventral clearance proxies. Check that the rim rolls inward, closes around the underside and leaves a persistent seam.

part_gaps.function: Occluding a burrow opening with the rump
part_gaps.gap: A broad caudal shield follows the terminal pelvic contour and provides a continuous backward contact face above the flexed hindlimbs. A dorsal plate omits the vertical rump-to-tunnel fit.
part_gaps.reference_query: Seek measured lateral and caudal standing views and authenticated anatomy of the dermal rump shield, plus hindlimb posture when backing into a tunnel.
part_gaps.model_scope: Rump envelope over the caudal pelvis, ending at the outer boundaries of the hindlimb fold.
part_gaps.local_fixture: Use a pelvic block, hinged upper legs and adjustable tunnel aperture. Check caudal wall overlap and a clear inward hinge path for the legs.

part_gaps.function: Accommodating motion under a thick external shoulder fold
part_gaps.gap: An external ridge has an adjacent deep crease running from a torso-fixed end onto the moving upper limb. In motion one lip can ride over the other while the continuous crease changes depth.
part_gaps.reference_query: Scale-bearing lateral and three-quarter adult shoulder views with the same foreleg advanced and retracted, exposing the crease under the overhanging ridge.
part_gaps.model_scope: One shoulder fold with torso-fixed and humerus-following attachment regions.
part_gaps.local_fixture: Use a curved torso surface and rotating upper limb. Check fold continuity, clearance under the lip and crease depth across poses.

part_gaps.function: Supporting an offspring in a trunk-side recess
part_gaps.gap: A flexible rim surrounds an opening with depth and a directed entrance into a blind pocket. A projecting neck fold provides no route through the host surface into a bounded cavity.
part_gaps.reference_query: Seek a scale-bearing lateral and ventral anatomy record for an adult female, showing pouch entrance orientation, rim shape and cavity depth from a sectional view.
part_gaps.model_scope: Pouch entrance, flexible lip and shallow cavity on a localized abdominal patch.
part_gaps.local_fixture: Use a curved abdominal panel and an inert ellipsoid. Check passage in the open pose, controlled closure around the entrance and watertight rim attachment.

part_gaps.function: Wrapping and gripping a branch with a tail pad
part_gaps.gap: A continuous distal ventral strip follows the inside of the coil and presents a compressed contact band to the branch. A uniformly skinned tail can coil without preserving a differentiated gripping surface.
part_gaps.reference_query: Scale-bearing ventral distal-tail view and lateral photographs of the same tail wrapped about a branch, with the bare lower strip and its terminal extent exposed.
part_gaps.model_scope: One distal tail chain with a ventral contact strip and defined proximal transition.
part_gaps.local_fixture: Use a tail root and branch cylinders. Check that only the ventral strip bears on the branch through a partial-to-full wrap and remains continuous under curvature.

part_gaps.function: Walking with claws clear of the ground
part_gaps.gap: The long digit claws turn in beneath the forefoot while a dorsal knuckle contact bears weight. The contact plane and resting claw recess are on different sides of the flexed digit chain.
part_gaps.reference_query: Scale-bearing frontal and lateral stance frames plus plantar and dorsal photographs of a specimen forefoot illustrating the reverted claws and walking contact surface.
part_gaps.model_scope: Distal forelimb, flexed middle digit cluster and dorsal support landmarks.
part_gaps.local_fixture: Use a wrist joint and floor plate. Check claw clearance in stance and compare ground contact at the knuckle line with a lifted reference pose.

part_gaps.function: Making a rattle with the tail
part_gaps.gap: Short hollow quills have expanded cup-like ends on narrow stalks. The movable tips need wall thickness and a shared collision envelope rather than the taper and fixed spacing of pointed spines.
part_gaps.reference_query: Seek scale-bearing end-on and side views of the distal tail showing quill openings and stalk insertions. Find a close recording of the same cluster while shaking.
part_gaps.model_scope: One small cluster of open-ended quills with individually attached stalks on a distal tail patch.
part_gaps.local_fixture: Use an oscillating tail mount. Check that cup rims can touch neighboring quills during offset motion and that stalks and openings remain clear at rest.

part_gaps.gap: Two forward digits share a proximal sleeve while separate terminal segments bend around the perch. Toe strings with only a basal pivot cannot represent the joined length and distal break point.
part_gaps.reference_query: Measure a scale-bearing plantar mount and medial oblique view of an adult foot in repose and gripping a small perch, with the proximal union traced.
part_gaps.model_scope: Tarsal tip, joined forward digit sleeve, free tips and rear countergrip.
part_gaps.local_fixture: Use a small perch cylinder. Check paired proximal motion and available distal flexion without tearing the junction.

part_gaps.function: Gripping opposing sides of a vertical support
part_gaps.gap: Two forward and two rear gripping rays originate in fore and aft pairs around one tarsal tip. These fixed opposition axes need joint placement distinct from a single opposable toe or a reversible outer talon.
part_gaps.reference_query: Scale-bearing plantar specimen image and true side photographs of a bird on a vertical trunk. Require exposed origins for both rear toes and their positions at contact.
part_gaps.model_scope: Tarsal tip and four digit bases arranged as opposing pairs with curved final joints.
part_gaps.local_fixture: Use a tarsal hinge and two diameters of vertical cylinder. Check two opposing contact pairs and root clearance during release.

part_gaps.function: Carrying stance on a central toe with lateral support
part_gaps.gap: A large central support toe has a full longitudinal contact strip, with a shorter lateral toe making a separate off-axis contact. The toes have separate sole cushions and do not form a hard paired hoof.
part_gaps.reference_query: Seek scale-bearing adult dorsal and plantar specimens and frontal photographs at midstance, with both toe axes, their pad footprints and the raised tarsal axis.
part_gaps.model_scope: Distal tarsus and both toe chains with their plantar contact regions.
part_gaps.local_fixture: Use a ground plate and a tarsal rotation mount. Check load contact on the central toe and preservation of the separate lateral contact as the foot rolls.

part_gaps.function: Bracing below the feet during vertical climbing
part_gaps.gap: Stiff central rectrices project below the rump and terminate in a paired prop contact. Their overlapping neighbor feathers need clearance to follow the tail angle without taking over the main contact.
part_gaps.reference_query: Scale-bearing lateral photograph of an adult tail pressed against a vertical trunk and an underside spread skin view showing the central shaft axes and tip contact locations.
part_gaps.model_scope: Rectrix root, central support pair and immediately adjacent feather margins.
part_gaps.local_fixture: Use a movable rump block and rough vertical plane. Check two stable tail-tip contacts through the braced pose and clean release.

part_gaps.function: Opening an independently controlled wing leading-edge panel
part_gaps.gap: A digit-rooted feather cluster can lift ahead of the main leading edge and create a narrow gap independently of the primary feather fan. Its local pivot precedes the wrist-tip feather hinge.
part_gaps.reference_query: Seek calibrated dorsal and anterior close-ups of the same distal wing with alula flush and elevated. The digit root and intervening slot need to be visible.
part_gaps.model_scope: One tapered alula cluster, root hinge and short wing edge segment.
part_gaps.local_fixture: Use a wing wrist mount and fixed leading-edge section. Check closure when flush and measurable slot height without feather-body clipping when raised.

part_gaps.function: Gripping a branch with the juvenile wing
part_gaps.gap: Two free clawed digits project from the juvenile wing hand and can wrap a branch while developing wing surfaces remain clear. A single free thumb or a continuous flight edge misses the two-digit reach and release.
part_gaps.reference_query: Find scale-bearing dorsal and side images of a climbing-age nestling wing and a branch-clinging view with both claw insertions and the wrist visible.
part_gaps.model_scope: Two distal wing digits, unguals and transition into the wing hand.
part_gaps.local_fixture: Use a wrist hinge, a short wing panel and a branch cylinder. Check that both tips can contact the cylinder without wing-edge collision.

part_gaps.function: Making sound through contact between wings
part_gaps.gap: Two modified wing feathers include a ridged shaft region and an adjacent bent shaft that sweeps it. An aerodynamic feather array lacks a matching sliding contact pair.
part_gaps.reference_query: Seek scale-bearing high-speed dorsal frames of male wing display plus close images of the modified secondary shafts showing the stridulatory ridge spacing and offset bend.
part_gaps.model_scope: Two modified secondaries and their neighboring wing-root positions.
part_gaps.local_fixture: Use a small moving wing plate. Check sweep overlap over the ridged zone and clear space before and after contact.

part_gaps.function: Modifying the exposed edge of a flight vane
part_gaps.gap: Discrete curved comb teeth rise along the exposed leading edge of an outer primary. These tooth roots must stay in the vane edge under bend, separate from slots between adjacent feather tips.
part_gaps.reference_query: Measure a scale-bearing isolated outer primary from above and edge-on, including a macro view giving the tooth pitch and inclination. Locate it in a spread wing view.
part_gaps.model_scope: One primary leading-edge segment with a repeatable curved tooth row.
part_gaps.local_fixture: Use a curved vane coupon and neighboring feather plane. Bend the coupon and check visible tooth pitch, lift and neighboring-vane clearance.

part_gaps.gap: Distinct inner and outer barb regions change arrangement when wet so adjacent barbules create a volume between overlapping filaments. It requires an explicit deployable lattice instead of a solid vane.
part_gaps.reference_query: Seek scale-bearing micrographs and cross-sectional views of male belly feathers from the same feather region in dry and saturated states.
part_gaps.model_scope: A short shaft and an enlarged repeatable patch of adjacent inner and outer barbs.
part_gaps.local_fixture: Use a shaft clamp and dry and wet target envelope gauges. Check geometry change and preservation of a measurable open volume between filaments.

part_gaps.function: Closing a warm cover over a foot-supported egg
part_gaps.gap: A dependent abdominal fold drapes over an object on top of the feet to form a three-sided enclosure. Its opening and contact path depend on a separate floor formed by the pes.
part_gaps.reference_query: Seek a scale-bearing frontal and true lateral view of an adult balancing an egg, with fold attachment and foot-top clearance visible during transfer and coverage.
part_gaps.model_scope: Abdominal drape, flexing lower edge and two foot-top contact proxies.
part_gaps.local_fixture: Use a curved ventral mount, foot platform and egg ellipsoid. Check that the lip closes around the egg during coverage and clears it during transfer.

part_gaps.function: Carrying a contact projection on the leg shaft
part_gaps.gap: A separate sheath projects from the tarsal shaft above the toe roots, seated around a raised spur base. A terminal claw rotates with a digit and cannot represent this mid-shaft insertion.
part_gaps.reference_query: Measure medial and caudomedial adult male tarsus photos and a specimen view of the spur core. Seek a ruler and an unambiguously visible spur axis and base.
part_gaps.model_scope: One tarsal spur core, outer sheath and surrounding raised mount.
part_gaps.local_fixture: Use a cylindrical tarsal segment plus hinged toe proxies. Check sheath seating and distal clearance through toe flexion.

part_gaps.gap: Two effective feather shafts leave one calamus and carry loose barbs in separate branches. Overlap depends on their shared root and paired distal silhouettes, distinct from neighboring single-shaft feathers.
part_gaps.reference_query: Seek scale-bearing flat and edge-on views of a single adult body feather with the two shaft bases visible and a matched close-up of feather overlap on the torso.
part_gaps.model_scope: One intact double-shaft body feather and a small repeatable overlap patch.
part_gaps.local_fixture: Use a single root socket and two neighboring copies on a curved torso. Check separate contours and uninterrupted planned overlap at their free edges.

part_gaps.function: Raising a dorsal display while supporting it with the true tail
part_gaps.gap: The dominant fan is formed by extended upper coverts rising in front of a shorter rectrix support plane. The two groups attach at different levels and move together during elevation.
part_gaps.reference_query: Seek calibrated true lateral and posterior frames of an adult male in lowered and full display, with both the short underlying rectrices and long covert bases visible.
part_gaps.model_scope: One dorsal covert fan above a separate rectrix support plane and both root tiers.
part_gaps.local_fixture: Use two roots on a rump block. Check the visible support overlap when elevated and ensure margin clearance when the train lowers.

part_gaps.function: Maintaining a closed flight-feather vane under bending
part_gaps.gap: Opposing barbule edges mate via visible hooks across the gap between adjacent barbs, producing a reversible seam inside one feather. Feather outlines and row overlap do not capture this interface.
part_gaps.reference_query: Seek calibrated microscopy of adjacent primary feather barbs and hooked barbules from a matched feather region, with oblique views of engaged and separated edges.
part_gaps.model_scope: An enlarged local strip with two neighboring barbs and repeated opposed barbules.
part_gaps.local_fixture: Use paired mounts on a vane bend jig. Check repeatable hook engagement at rest and measurable edge separation through the release pose.

part_gaps.gap: The adhesive footprint includes anterior and posterior regions formed at the pectoral and pelvic bases. Their extended rim and papilla fields require different seating from the goby pelvic-only rim.
part_gaps.reference_query: Ventral specimen macro of the complete disc and girdle landmarks, lateral contact section and a released rim view.
part_gaps.model_scope: One ventral disc rim, its supported anterior and posterior regions, and coarse papilla fields.
part_gaps.local_fixture: A short belly saddle over a transparent plane and a convex cobble, with rim contact and release checked separately.

part_gaps.gap: Short repeatable, independently rooted fins form dorsal and ventral rows separated by exposed skin. A common placement and angle rig must preserve the gaps and diminishing footprint.
part_gaps.reference_query: Direct side and rear three-quarter images from second dorsal and anal fin to caudal peduncle, with a swimming sequence showing root motion.
part_gaps.model_scope: One finlet module and a repeated row with progressively smaller bases.
part_gaps.local_fixture: A tapered posterior trunk section with opposing rows and clearance to the first caudal root throughout a tail beat.

part_gaps.gap: Each serial module carries its own leading spine and trailing membrane. A folding row must preserve the individual spine-to-web boundary and seat each base independently.
part_gaps.reference_query: Lateral and dorsal close-ups of the posterior dorsal row raised and laid down, with one finlet base and free triangular membrane visible.
part_gaps.model_scope: A spine-and-web module repeated along a short run, with separate pivots and shared root spacing control.
part_gaps.local_fixture: A curved dorsal strip supporting three modules with controlled overlap at rest and separation when raised.

part_gaps.gap: A stout leading spine locks in its raised pose when the second spine engages its base. The paired pivots and contact surfaces define the assembly.
part_gaps.reference_query: Lateral and dorsal macro views of the first dorsal erected and recessed, plus a skeletal or anatomical view showing the first two spine bases.
part_gaps.model_scope: Two articulated dorsal spines, their lock surfaces, and a shallow receiving groove.
part_gaps.local_fixture: A short dorsal patch with the groove floor visible in section. Test raised lock contact, release, and the lowered silhouette.

part_gaps.gap: Long pelvic spines seat on opposite sides of a shared ventral girdle plate. Each can clear the belly when erected, with its own seat and pivot.
part_gaps.reference_query: Ventral and oblique views of a fully armored adult showing the shield, each spine base and folded versus spread spine poses.
part_gaps.model_scope: A single ventral pelvic shield and its two lateral spine seats, with movable spines.
part_gaps.local_fixture: A belly strip keyed to one girdle plate. Check each spine clears the opposite side and folds to its own rest path.

part_gaps.gap: A laterally mounted blade hinges from a body groove on the caudal peduncle. Blade deployment exposes a cutting edge and leaves a visible recessed seat.
part_gaps.reference_query: Unobstructed caudal peduncle lateral and rear oblique specimen views, plus a documented extended and recessed scalpel comparison.
part_gaps.model_scope: One peduncular blade, local pivot, and receiving slot, with a mirrored install.
part_gaps.local_fixture: A short elliptical peduncle with blade on each flank. Check flush rest and clearance to the tail base on deployment.

part_gaps.gap: A flattened, serrated blade has an extended root running along the dorsal tail surface. The exposed edges and tail seat require a different construction from a terminal tapering sting.
part_gaps.reference_query: Dorsal and lateral views of the in-place caudal spine and a scale-bearing image of a shed spine showing the paired serrations.
part_gaps.model_scope: One sting section with a buried longitudinal root and serrated margins, plus a coarse sheath only where visible.
part_gaps.local_fixture: A flexible tail segment bending under the attachment. Check that the root stays seated and both free margins clear the tail.

part_gaps.gap: Fused polygonal scutes form a faceted enclosure whose rigid corners run across dorsal and ventral panels. Fin openings interrupt the plates.
part_gaps.reference_query: Subadult dorsal, ventral and end-on specimen views of armor corners, scute sutures and median-fin openings.
part_gaps.model_scope: A trunk armor shell section with a dorsal and a ventrolateral corner, visible sutures, and one fin opening.
part_gaps.local_fixture: A faceted torso mandrel with a replaceable fin root. Check uninterrupted corner, aperture clearance, and seam thickness.

part_gaps.gap: Separate projecting bony scutes form one dorsal, two lateral and two ventrolateral rows, leaving substantial skin between rows. Root orientation differs at each row.
part_gaps.reference_query: Juvenile dorsal, side and ventral views through the same trunk segment; close-ups of a lateral scute and neighboring skin.
part_gaps.model_scope: A scute module with row-specific section and footprint, repeated over one short trunk station.
part_gaps.local_fixture: A tapered five-sided trunk coupon with three scutes per row and flex sufficient to check neighboring scute clearance.

part_gaps.gap: The phenotype is a single skin envelope that expands around the trunk while fin roots and the anterior and posterior transitions remain constrained. A surface bulge leaves separate seams at these boundaries.
part_gaps.reference_query: Matched lateral and ventral views of relaxed and naturally inflated specimens showing the belly outline and unchanged fin insertions.
part_gaps.model_scope: The abdominal and flank envelope with fixed attachment boundaries and an inflated shape key.
part_gaps.local_fixture: Short shoulder and posterior rings with belly and flank sections between, using dummy fin roots to check displacement and clearance.

part_gaps.gap: Dermal spines rotate from a laid-back rest pose towards radial extension as the surrounding skin expands. Each spine needs an embedded base and a linked distribution over the deforming host.
part_gaps.reference_query: Matched relaxed and naturally inflated flank macros showing spine bases, resting direction and standing projection.
part_gaps.model_scope: A repeatable patch of spine roots and exposed shafts driven by local skin expansion.
part_gaps.local_fixture: One elastic flank coupon with a bounded area change. Check skin penetration at both poses and tip clearance between neighbors.

part_gaps.gap: Two elongated belly folds flank the incubation surface and meet along a longitudinal closure. That seam and its recessed interior require two separately seated edges.
part_gaps.reference_query: Adult male ventral and oblique views at empty and brooding stages, with labeled pouch cross-section showing the lateral folds.
part_gaps.model_scope: One paired brood enclosure with seam edges and a shallow internal cavity.
part_gaps.local_fixture: A narrow ventral trunk saddle with an interchangeable clutch volume. Check closure, fold clearance, and an empty pose.

part_gaps.gap: Short maternal stalks connect the ventral skin to individual carried eggs. Each unit must carry a terminal body while leaving exposed skin between stalks.
part_gaps.reference_query: Ventral macro and side-lit oblique view of a brooding female, plus labeled detail of one stalk and its egg interface.
part_gaps.model_scope: A small repeatable set of ventral stalks with removable egg surrogates.
part_gaps.local_fixture: A curved abdominal skin coupon with staggered stalks. Check stalk seating, egg separations and nearby belly clearance.

part_gaps.gap: Multiple decorative blades emerge on narrow stalks with individual roots distributed over flank and tail. Their leaf-like surfaces can remain distinct when the local host curves.
part_gaps.reference_query: Lateral and opposite oblique close-ups of the same trunk-to-tail appendage group, including clear branch roots and blade edges.
part_gaps.model_scope: One localized cluster of individually rooted stalked blades from the trunk-to-tail region.
part_gaps.local_fixture: An armored taper coupon that bends laterally. Check stalk rooting and free blade clearance on concave and convex bends.

part_gaps.gap: Long segmented fin rays spread a collapsible membrane fan and close into a narrow flank-aligned bundle. The motion requires a ray fan at a compact fish fin root.
part_gaps.reference_query: Matched dorsal and lateral views of an adult with pectorals fully spread and closed. Include pectoral roots and ray spacing.
part_gaps.model_scope: One ray-and-membrane pectoral fan with a shoulder seat and spread control.
part_gaps.local_fixture: A curved flank strip with a reference pelvic-fin marker. Check the stored profile, full fan opening and clearance to the neighboring fin.

part_gaps.gap: A thick fleshy proximal lobe has a movable distal transition into a fin-ray fan. The lobe, distal flex axis and terminal fan require distinct sections and articulation.
part_gaps.reference_query: In situ lateral and anteroventral swimming views, plus a preserved pectoral fin dorsal view exposing the fleshy lobe to ray boundary.
part_gaps.model_scope: One proximal pectoral lobe, its distal flex region and the continuous ray fan.
part_gaps.local_fixture: A lateral girdle puck with a curved trunk section behind it. Verify internal flex and folded fin-to-trunk clearance.

part_gaps.gap: A short, fleshy pectoral lever puts the distal ray fan onto a load-bearing contact plane, with the fin root and elbow-like bend turning independently.
part_gaps.reference_query: Low lateral and ventral-oblique close-ups of one pectoral through body support and recovery, retaining the base and substrate.
part_gaps.model_scope: One pectoral crutch with seated proximal hinge, elbow-like flexion, and distal contact fan.

terrestrial_mammals.label: Terrestrial, arboreal and semiaquatic mammals
terrestrial_mammals.gap: The baseline concentrates on digitigrade carnivorans and an ape.
terrestrial_mammals.next_sources: Compare monotreme feet, xenarthran armor, ungulate feet and digging specialists with scale-bearing museum views.

flying_mammals.label: Bats
flying_mammals.gap: The complementary membrane-wing family has no underlying bat species record in the original research.
flying_mammals.next_sources: Compare wing, thumb, tail membrane and nose-leaf landmarks across families with spread and folded specimen views.

marine_mammals.label: Cetaceans, pinnipeds and sirenians
marine_mammals.gap: The original species census has no marine mammals.
marine_mammals.next_sources: Compare fluke, flipper, blowhole, baleen and muzzle architectures across these groups.

birds.label: Birds
birds.gap: The legacy bird model rests on a raptor. Bill, foot and wing diversity is poorly sampled.
birds.next_sources: Use museum specimen views and feeding studies of shorebirds, waterfowl, penguins, parrots, pelicans and nectar feeders.

reptiles.label: Reptiles
reptiles.gap: The original reptile evidence is one iguana. Snake, crocodilian, gecko and turtle mechanics lack numeric source rows.
reptiles.next_sources: Capture gecko toe underside, turtle shell profile, crocodilian jaw articulation and snake scale or jaw landmarks.

amphibians.label: Amphibians
amphibians.gap: The frog baseline excludes salamanders and caecilians.
amphibians.next_sources: Find larval-to-adult gill views, toe-pad structures, and limbless head morphology in specimen collections.

cartilaginous_fish.label: Sharks, rays and chimaeras
cartilaginous_fish.gap: One shark dominates the legacy description of fins and gill openings.
cartilaginous_fish.next_sources: Document ray pectoral continuity and cephalic lobes, sawfish rostra and chimaera fin and face morphology.

bony_fish.label: Ray-finned and lobe-finned fishes
bony_fish.gap: The original fish sample contains no bony fish.
bony_fish.next_sources: Sample caudal alternatives, opercula, hinged hyoids, suction attachments, lures and benthic fin supports.

insects.label: Insects
insects.gap: The beetle supplies most legacy insect features.
insects.next_sources: Compare dorsal and ventral wing, mouthpart, leg and ovipositor structures across contrasting orders and life stages.

crustaceans.label: Crustaceans
crustaceans.gap: The legacy crab has no published comparison against swimmers, filter feeders or non-chelate grasping limbs.
crustaceans.next_sources: Measure separated swimmerets, tail fans, raptorial appendages, barnacle cirri and scraper mouthparts.

other_arthropods.label: Arachnids, horseshoe crabs, myriapods and sea spiders
other_arthropods.gap: Original evidence covers one scorpion only.
other_arthropods.next_sources: Gather reference views of spider pedipalps and spinnerets, book gills, ovigers and anterior centipede limb modifications.

molluscs.label: Molluscs
molluscs.gap: The legacy octopus does not cover shelled cephalopods, walking or crawling molluscs, hinged shells, or gilled mantle openings.
molluscs.next_sources: Capture gastropod opercula, bivalve valves and hinges, segmented chiton plates and nautilus shell-to-hood contact.

echinoderms.label: Echinoderms
echinoderms.gap: The original project has no echinoderm source rows.
echinoderms.next_sources: Compare oral and aboral views of sea stars, brittle stars, urchins, crinoids and sea cucumbers.

cnidarians.label: Cnidarians and ctenophores
cnidarians.gap: The legacy census has a single scyphozoan and no attached or branching body plans.
cnidarians.next_sources: Record marginal appendage patterns, comb rows and colonial modules using licensing-verified microscopy or drawings.

worms.label: Annelids, nemerteans, flatworms and allied worm forms
worms.next_sources: Find scale-bearing views for parapodia, chaeta arrangements, sucker discs, branchial crowns and eversible structures.

other_invertebrates.label: Other invertebrate body plans
other_invertebrates.gap: Sponges, bryozoans, tunicates and several other visible structural groups are unrepresented in the legacy data.
other_invertebrates.next_sources: Sample specimen scans or anatomy diagrams for siphon pairs, skeletal fans, lophophores and colony-to-module joints.

jawless_fish.label: Lampreys and hagfish
jawless_fish.gap: Jawless attachment and feeding structures are distinct from paired jaws and gill covers.
jawless_fish.next_sources: Use oral-disc views and resting versus attached profiles for living jawless fish.
